issue_request: FHIR-7444 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the FHIR XML page. It reported that the sentence 'Other processing Instructions SHOULD not be included, except and SHALL not be required...' had an incomplete 'except' clause.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN revision 5396, imported as Git commit 7fa168efa74a03f334bbfe31eec23503a653162f with subject '#7444 - tyop'. That commit removed the stray 'except' and clarified the second sentence to refer to processing instructions. Commit 86d17b7f2a4bcb5f397f0de81414c43cfaf1c6b1 later removed an unnecessary comma without changing the meaning.
additional_context: The current build source `source/xml.html` is the XML representation page referenced by the Jira issue. Current source says other processing instructions SHOULD not be included and SHALL NOT be required to properly understand or present resource data or narrative. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant or conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source is already correct and no current source occurrence of the broken 'except' wording remains.
